Chevron achieved significant global growth, record production levels, met its cost reduction target, and substantially decreased net debt, while returning cash to shareholders and raising its dividend for 38 consecutive years. The company is considered undervalued according to InvestingPro data.

events.title: RBC Capital Adjusts Gaming and Leisure Properties Price Target to $52 From $54, Maintains Outperform Rating
events.summary: RBC Capital has adjusted its price target for Gaming and Leisure Properties (GLPI) to $52, down from $54, while maintaining an Outperform rating on the stock. The article mentions recent financial updates for the company, including Q2 2026 earnings and revised 2026 guidance, and highlights the company's business model as a REIT focused on leasing properties to gaming operators.

events.title: Hess Midstream Raises Quarterly Distribution to $0.7888
events.summary: Hess Midstream LP reported second quarter 2026 net income of $173.7 million, with $0.75 basic earnings per Class A share attributable to Hess Midstream. The company increased its quarterly cash distribution to $0.7888 per Class A share and reaffirmed its full-year 2026 financial and throughput guidance, anticipating approximately $1 billion of Adjusted Free Cash Flow after Distributions through 2028. Operational highlights included decreased throughput volumes for oil terminaling, water gathering, and gas processing compared to the prior year.

events.title: Santos Stock And 2 Energy Names Exposed To Oil Route Risks
events.summary: Rising geopolitical tensions and threats to shipping routes in the Middle East have pushed oil prices higher, drawing attention to energy companies. This article examines three oil and gas stocks—Central Petroleum (ASX:CTP), Santos (ASX:STO), and Imperial Petroleum (IMPP)—highlighting their exposure to these risks and opportunities. It details their operations, market capitalization, and specific factors that could either support or pressure their performance in the current volatile environment.

events.title: Letter to Stockholders Issued by Diamondback Energy, Inc.
events.summary: Diamondback Energy, Inc. issued a letter to stockholders detailing its Q2 2026 operational and financial performance. The company reported a significant increase in oil and total production, raised full-year production guidance, and generated substantial free cash flow. Diamondback also outlined its strategies for debt reduction, share repurchases, and addressing gas takeaway issues in the Permian Basin, while also emphasizing its focus on Enhanced Oil Recovery and potential power generation opportunities.

events.title: Letter to Stockholders Issued by Diamondback Energy, Inc.
events.summary: Diamondback Energy, Inc. (FANG) issued a letter to stockholders detailing its Q2 2026 operational and financial performance, highlighting increased oil production and free cash flow despite a volatile macro backdrop caused by global oil supply shocks. The company raised its full-year oil production guidance, reduced debt, and doubled its share repurchase authorization to $16 billion, emphasizing capital efficiency and long-term stockholder value. Diamondback also discussed its strategies for gas monetization and the development of its chemical Enhanced Oil Recovery program, seeing significant potential for future growth and value creation in the Permian Basin.

events.title: Colgate-Palmolive Company (CL) PT Raised to $104 at RBC Capital
events.summary: RBC Capital analyst Nik Modi has increased the price target for Colgate-Palmolive Company (CL) to $104. This update, reported on August 3, 2026, indicates a positive outlook from the analyst for the consumer products giant. Further details of the analysis are available to premium subscribers of StreetInsider.com.

events.title: HF Sinclair’s Mississauga Base Oil Shift Expected Complete in 2027
events.summary: HF Sinclair's Lubricants & Specialties segment has established strategic long-term commercial agreements with SK Enmove and Chevron Products Company for the supply of Group III and Group II base oils, respectively. These agreements will create a diversified base oil supply network in North America and support HF Sinclair's plans to retire its base oil refining assets in Mississauga, Ontario, with the transition expected to be completed in the second half of 2027. The company will also distribute YUBASE Group III base oils for SK Enmove and Chevron-branded Group II base oils in North America.

events.title: Trump Chastises Chevron CEO for Failing to Praise Administration
events.summary: President Donald Trump publicly criticized Chevron CEO Mike Wirth for not acknowledging the administration's pro-fossil fuel policies in a recent interview. Trump also urged oil companies to lower pump prices, noting Chevron's record $12 billion profit in the second quarter due to soaring crude prices and refining margins amidst the US-Iran war.

events.title: CLASS ACTION DEADLINE TONIGHT: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Badger Meter (BMI) Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on August 3, 2026
events.summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP has reminded investors of Badger Meter (BMI) about the August 3, 2026 deadline to seek lead plaintiff status in a federal securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Badger Meter and its executives made false and misleading statements regarding the company's financial results and growth prospects. Investors who purchased BMI stock between April 18, 2024, and April 16, 2026, and suffered losses may be eligible to participate.

events.title: Chevron Expands Base Oils Network With New Partnerships
events.summary: Chevron (NYSE:CVX) is expanding its North American base oils distribution network through new partnerships with HF Sinclair Lubricants & Specialties and Renkert Oil. This move aims to enhance distribution capabilities and ensure reliable product supply for customers. The company recently reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, beating analyst expectations, and has received positive analyst ratings with an average price target of $211.57.

events.title: ConocoPhillips Says Venezuela’s Bid to Woo Oil Firms Falls Short
events.summary: ConocoPhillips CEO Ryan Lance states that Venezuela's current efforts to attract foreign oil companies are insufficient to incentivize investment, citing high government takes and unfavorable contract terms reminiscent of past asset seizures. Despite President Trump's administration pushing for changes to entice foreign capital, many companies remain skeptical. US Interior Secretary Doug Burgum remains optimistic that companies will pressure Venezuela to offer competitive terms, as they have global investment options.

events.title: Trump demands ExxonMobil, Chevron cut gas prices
events.summary: President Donald Trump has criticized ExxonMobil and Chevron for their substantial second-quarter profits amid the war in Iran, urging them to reduce gasoline prices. Both companies more than doubled their net income, while average gasoline prices exceed $4 per gallon. Trump had previously ordered the Justice Department to investigate potential price gouging.

events.title: 'Austin lets us build': Investment giant to build tech-focused growth hub
events.summary: Apollo Global Management, an investment firm with over $1 trillion in assets, has chosen Austin for a new strategic growth hub focused on technology, innovation, and business development. While New York remains its global headquarters, Austin was selected for its talent, technology, and business environment to build the "next generation of Apollo." This move reinforces Texas's growing status as a financial and tech center, attracting other major companies recently.

events.title: American Airlines Group Inc. (NASDAQ:AAL) Shares Rise While Oil Drop Lowers Fuel Costs; Margin Differential Remains
events.summary: American Airlines (NASDAQ:AAL) shares rose 4.7% to $15.99 after Brent crude prices declined by 4.8%. This drop in fuel costs is significant for American Airlines, which has the narrowest profit margin among its peers and typically sees a boost in earnings prospects from lower fuel expenses. Despite this positive movement, the company's adjusted operating margin of 2.7% for the second quarter still trails major rivals, and American remains the only airline projecting an adjusted loss for the third quarter.

events.title: INCE Dividend: 4.84% Yield, $3.29/Share — History & Dates
events.summary: The article provides a detailed analysis of Franklin Income Equity Focus ETF (INCE) dividends, highlighting its current dividend yield of 4.82% ($3.29 per share annually) and a payout ratio of 0.56. events.title: ‘Making too much money’: Trump blasts Exxon Mobil, Chevron profits
events.summary: Former President Donald Trump criticized Exxon Mobil and Chevron for making "too much money" while consumers face high gasoline prices. He urged the oil giants to lower retail prices and "give some of that back to the public" after both companies reported strong earnings. Trump also ordered the Justice Department to investigate oil companies for not reducing gas prices quickly enough and criticized Chevron's CEO for not attributing the company's success to his administration.

events.title: Diamondback Energy beats quarterly profit estimates, raises production forecast
events.summary: Diamondback Energy exceeded analysts' second-quarter profit expectations and increased its annual production forecast due to elevated global oil prices caused by Middle East supply disruptions. The company also doubled its share repurchase authorization to $16 billion and now expects to produce over 1 million barrels of oil equivalent per day in 2026. Realized oil prices were significantly higher, though warnings were issued about rising fixed costs in the Permian Basin.

events.title: YUM Stock Slides — Michigan Warned Taco Bell Weeks Before Public Cyclospora Alert, Report Says
events.summary: Michigan health officials reportedly contacted Yum! Brands, the parent company of Taco Bell, about a cyclospora outbreak in early July, weeks before the information was made public. Taco Bell voluntarily removed potentially affected ingredients from select Michigan restaurants based on state guidance, and later, federal health officials linked the outbreak to shredded lettuce supplied by Taylor Farms. YUM shares experienced a decline following these developments.

events.title: Chevron awards staff special bonus following earnings blowout
events.summary: Chevron announced a special bonus for employees, equivalent to half a month's base pay, following a record earnings report boosted by high oil prices. CEO Mike Wirth cited successful cost-reduction, early Hess deal synergies, and safe operations despite geopolitical challenges. The announcement comes as former U.S. President Donald Trump criticized major oil companies for high gasoline prices.

events.title: JBH Investment Trust plans major Chevron (CVX) stock sale after prior large disposals
events.summary: JBH Investment Trust, associated with Chevron Corporation, plans to sell 100,000 shares of Chevron common stock on or after August 3, 2026, through J.P. Morgan Securities LLC on the NYSE. This planned sale follows two significant disposals in May 2026, where the trust sold a total of 575,000 shares for over $109 million. The shares originate from a 1999 bequest from the Estate of Leon Hess.

events.title: Passive Income Play: Own This Many Chevron Shares for $1,000 a Year
events.summary: This article highlights Chevron (NYSE: CVX) as a strong dividend stock for passive income. It details that owning approximately 144 shares, an investment of about $27,248, would generate $1,000 per year given its 3.67% yield. Chevron's consistent dividend growth over 39 years and diversified energy operations are presented as key reasons for its reliability.

events.title: Petrol prices strain US households as oil giants Chevron, Exxon profits soar
events.summary: US households are struggling with rising petrol prices, with low-income families spending over 10% of their monthly income on fuel, while oil giants Chevron and ExxonMobil report soaring profits. President Donald Trump criticized these companies for their high earnings amidst a war with Iran impacting oil prices. This disparity has led to political pushback and calls for measures like suspending gas taxes to alleviate consumer burden.

events.title: Franklin Income Equity Focus ETF (INCE) ETF Holders - Institutional Ownership

events.title: Occidental Petroleum Earnings: What To Look For From OXY
events.summary: Occidental Petroleum (NYSE: OXY) is set to announce its earnings results this Wednesday. Analysts expect the company's revenue to grow by 36.2% year-on-year, a significant turnaround from the previous year's decrease. Peers like ExxonMobil and Chevron have already reported strong Q2 results, with positive sentiment in the upstream & integrated segment, and Occidental Petroleum's stock has seen a 13.9% increase over the last month.

events.title: Janus Henderson Group PLC Acquires 955,147 Shares of Tyra Biosciences, Inc. $TYRA
events.summary: Janus Henderson Group PLC has significantly increased its stake in Tyra Biosciences, Inc. (NASDAQ:TYRA) by purchasing an additional 955,147 shares, bringing its total holdings to 3.89 million shares valued at approximately $148.9 million. This acquisition makes Janus Henderson Group PLC one of the largest institutional holders with 6.54% of the company's stock, contributing to the overall institutional ownership of 84.14%. Despite a recent dip in share price and a quarterly earnings miss, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for Tyra Biosciences with an average price target of $47.

events.title: BP profit more than doubles as Trump blasts Big Oil for ‘making too much money’
events.summary: BP reported a second-quarter net profit of $5.7 billion, more than double the previous year, significantly exceeding analyst expectations. This surge in profit comes amidst rising fossil fuel prices due to the Middle East conflict, and shortly after former U.S. President Donald Trump criticized major oil companies for making "too much money." BP CEO Meg O'Neill addressed these criticisms, emphasizing the company's focus on operational efficiency and debt reduction.

events.title: Confluence Investment Management LLC Has $62.45 Million Stock Holdings in Diageo plc $DEO
events.summary: Confluence Investment Management LLC significantly reduced its stake in Diageo plc (DEO) by 42.6% in the second quarter, now holding 776,936 shares valued at $62.45 million. Despite this reduction, institutional ownership remains at 8.97%, with some funds like Dimensional Fund Advisors increasing their positions. Analysts currently have a mixed sentiment, with an average "Hold" rating and a consensus price target of $106.25, while the stock recently traded at $88.55.

events.title: Diamondback Energy, Inc. $FANG Shares Bought by Bank of America Corp DE
events.summary: Bank of America Corp DE increased its stake in Diamondback Energy (NASDAQ:FANG) by 4.5% in the first quarter, bringing its total holdings to 1.37 million shares valued at $270.6 million. This comes as Diamondback reported strong Q2 earnings, with adjusted EPS of $6.48 and revenue of $5.56 billion, beating estimates and raising its 2026 production outlook. Despite positive analyst sentiment and a consensus "Buy" rating, the stock's high valuation and reliance on elevated oil prices remain key risks, with insiders selling over $21.6 million in shares recently.

events.title: BP to sell Archaea Energy as it withdraws from biogas
events.summary: BP is divesting its Archaea Energy biogas business, a move disclosed in its Q2 results as part of a corporate portfolio simplification drive. Despite an initial $4.1bn acquisition in 2022 to expand in the US biogas industry and support decarbonisation, BP is now cutting back on non-core assets due to costs and liabilities not being resilient in a low price environment. While withdrawing from direct biogas operations, BP will maintain a partnership with Clean Energy Fuels Corp for renewable natural gas from dairy cow manure.

events.title: Hafnia Ltd (HAFN) Risk Assessment: Volatility, Financial Risk & Investment Risk
events.summary: This article provides a risk assessment for Hafnia Ltd (HAFN), noting its current risk score of 7.44 and ranking within the Oil & Gas Related Equipment and Services industry. events.summary: The article argues that the Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD)'s advertised low expense ratio of 0.06% obscures significant hidden costs for taxable investors. The March 2026 reconstitution of its underlying index led to large taxable distributions, such as $0.8241 per share in Q2 2024, far exceeding its typical quarterly dividend. Furthermore, the ETF is noted for its concentration in a few large holdings and its underperformance compared to other dividend-growth ETFs over various periods.

events.title: Trump says oil companies Chevron and Exxon Mobil made ‘too much money’
events.summary: Donald Trump criticized major oil companies Chevron and Exxon Mobil for making "too much money" due to high oil prices, urging them to reduce retail prices and give profits back to the public. He also stated that newly planned talks with Iran are its "last chance" to make a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and address its nuclear program, warning of escalating U.S. strikes if negotiations fail. Trump expressed frustration with Iran's leadership for allegedly being duplicitous about the nature of the ongoing discussions.

events.title: HF Sinclair inks supply deals amid pending segment spinoff, refinery closure
events.summary: HF Sinclair is preparing for the spinoff of its lubricants and specialties business by establishing long-term supply agreements with SK Enmove and Chevron Products. This move coincides with the planned retirement of its Mississauga, Ontario, refinery by year-end 2027. The new agreements will ensure a diversified North American base oil supply network, allowing the independent lubricants-specialty company to offer a full range of Group I, II, and III base oils post-spinoff.

events.title: BP Raises Dividend Rate
events.summary: BP PLC announced a four percent increase in its quarterly dividend to 8.66 cents per share, driven by higher oil prices despite lower upstream and refining volumes. For CEO Meg O'Neill's first full quarter, underlying replacement cost profit rose significantly to $5.73 billion. The company also reported plans to divest its US biogas business, Archaea Energy, as part of a simplification campaign, acknowledging past performance has not met expectations.

events.title: Second quarter 2026 results
events.summary: BP reported stronger financial performance in the second quarter of 2026, with underlying RC profit reaching $5.7 billion, a significant increase from the previous quarter, and operating cash flow of $10.9 billion. Despite operational challenges like reduced upstream reliability and refining throughput, the company progressed in strengthening its balance sheet and simplifying its portfolio through strategic divestments. CEO Meg O’Neill outlined five key priorities, including balance sheet strengthening, disciplined investment, and operational excellence, to drive a step change in performance and enhance shareholder value.

events.title: Trump says oil companies Chevron and Exxon Mobil made ‘too much money’
events.summary: President Donald Trump stated that major oil companies like Chevron and Exxon Mobil made "too much money" due to high oil prices, urging them to return some profits to the public and cut retail prices. He also declared that newly planned talks with Tehran represent Iran's "last chance" to make a deal and avoid escalating U.S. strikes, emphasizing the need to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and address Iran's nuclear program. Trump criticized Iranian leadership for allegedly being duplicitous regarding these negotiations.

events.title: Why Trump Has Blasted ExxonMobil (NYSE: XOM) And Chevron (NYSE: CVX) Over "Too Much Money"
events.summary: President Donald Trump has publicly criticized ExxonMobil and Chevron for their excessive profits during the ongoing U.S.-led war against Iran. He called on the companies to reduce retail gasoline prices, arguing they are making "too much money" amid national strain. This rebuke comes as both companies reported significant second-quarter profits, with Trump linking the issue to public responsibility and upcoming midterm elections.

events.title: Northrop names former Chevron investor relations head Randy Sinclair to lead IR (NOC:NYSE)
events.summary: Northrop Grumman Corporation has appointed Randy Sinclair, formerly Chevron's investor relations head, as its new vice president of investor relations. Sinclair will report to CFO John Greene, with his appointment becoming effective on August 10.

events.title: PR News | Chevron’s Sinclair Jumps to Northrop Grumman - Tue., Aug. 4, 2026
events.summary: Randy Sinclair, who previously led investor relations at Chevron, is moving to Northrop Grumman as VP-IR, effective August 10. This move follows Northrop Grumman's recent $3 billion deal to accelerate the production of the Patriot anti-missile system. Sinclair brings 11 years of experience from Chevron, where he held various corporate finance and strategy roles.

events.title: TXO Partners (NYSE: TXO) sets $0.40 payout, eyes Elm Coulee growth
events.summary: TXO Partners (NYSE: TXO) has declared a cash distribution of $0.40 per common unit for Q2 2026, payable on August 21, 2026. This payout is supported by a 2026 capital program focused on increasing capital efficiency and productivity through longer well laterals, particularly in the Elm Coulee field in Montana. The company emphasizes its low-decline, conventional asset base across the Permian, San Juan, and Williston basins, and its variable distribution policy.

events.title: Suncor Energy reports second quarter 2026 results
events.summary: Suncor Energy reported strong second-quarter 2026 results, achieving record adjusted funds from operations of $5.3 billion and free funds flow of $4.0 billion. The company announced plans to increase monthly share repurchases to $500 million starting August 2026, and highlighted robust performance in its downstream business, with record refining throughput and refined product sales. Overall, Suncor demonstrated significant shareholder value creation and operational efficiency gains.

events.title: SSR Mining Q2 2026 slides: $1.8B cash, buybacks amid earnings miss
events.summary: SSR Mining (NASDAQ:SSRM) released its Q2 2026 financial results, missing Wall Street's earnings and revenue expectations but showcasing a strong balance sheet with $1.8 billion in cash and zero debt. The company completed its strategic shift to an Americas-focused portfolio, divesting its Turkish assets and emphasizing shareholder returns through aggressive share buybacks and a reinstated dividend program. Despite the market's negative reaction to the earnings miss, analysts maintain a bullish outlook based on the company's financial strength, U.S. gold producer leadership, and brownfield growth opportunities.

events.title: Trump slams Exxon, Chevron for profits amid war
events.summary: Former President Donald Trump criticized ExxonMobil and Chevron for their substantial profits, urging them to lower retail petrol prices and give back to the public. The oil companies reported combined profits of US$29 billion in the second quarter, more than triple the previous year, driven by high oil prices from the war in Iran. Trump also took credit for the industry's success, stating that without his administration, the oil industry and the country would be "DEAD!".

events.title: How Investors May Respond To Black Stone Minerals (BSM) Expected Q2 Revenue Drop Amid Earlier Oil Strength
events.summary: Black Stone Minerals (BSM) is anticipated to report a significant year-over-year revenue decline for Q2 2026, prompting investor scrutiny despite earlier strength in oil production. The key concern is whether the company's underlying production and margins can sustain current distributions given the expected revenue drop, especially as its growth relies heavily on third-party operators. Analysts are closely watching how this tension between volume and revenue will impact the company's ability to maintain stable cash flows.

events.title: BP profit soars as Mideast war roils energy prices
events.summary: BP's net profit more than doubled in the second quarter of 2026, reaching $3.91 billion, as the ongoing Middle East war significantly impacted oil and gas markets. The company, along with other major Western energy firms, saw substantial earnings due to disrupted global supplies and soaring fossil fuel prices. CEO Meg O'Neill is spearheading a strategic pivot back to oil and gas, divesting from clean energy and non-core businesses like its North Sea operations and the Archaea biogas business.

events.title: CVE|Cenovus Energy Inc|Price:29.605|Chg%:-0.585
events.summary: Cenovus Energy Inc. (CVE) shows strong fundamentals and high growth potential, despite recent stock price fluctuations. The stock is currently trading sideways, making it suitable for range-bound swing trading according to technical analysis.

events.title: EOG Resources Doubles Q2 Profit as Oil Prices and Production Rise
events.summary: EOG Resources reported a significant increase in its second-quarter 2026 net income, doubling to $2.72 billion, largely driven by higher oil prices and increased production. The company's revenue rose by 57% year-over-year, and it generated substantial operating and free cash flow. EOG also expanded its operations internationally with initial oil production in the United Arab Emirates and plans for continued production growth in 2026.

events.title: Chevron Q2 2026 Earnings: Record Production Drives a Sharp Profit Increase
events.summary: Chevron reported a sharp increase in Q2 2026 earnings, with net income reaching $12.1 billion, driven by record production, higher commodity prices, and contributions from acquired Hess assets. The company's sales and operating revenues rose 51% to $67.2 billion, and diluted EPS increased significantly. Chevron also reduced its total debt by $8.4 billion and declared a quarterly dividend of $1.78 per share, while achieving Hess synergy targets ahead of schedule.

events.title: Ring Energy Releases Second Quarter 2026 Results, Advances Development Program and Provides Initial 2027 Outlook
events.summary: Ring Energy, Inc. reported strong operational and financial results for the second quarter of 2026, including a significant increase in net income and Adjusted EBITDA, and a reduction in borrowings. The company is advancing its development program with a focus on longer lateral horizontal wells, which is expected to enhance capital efficiency and improve economic returns. Ring Energy also provided initial 2027 guidance targeting production growth, lower operating expenses, and reduced capital expenditures.

events.title: Golar FLNG unit leaves Cameroon for Singapore upgrade stopover
events.summary: Golar LNG's FLNG unit Hilli Episeyo has departed Cameroon en route to Singapore for an upgrade. This move is in preparation for its 20-year charter in Argentina, where it is expected to commence operations by mid-2027.

events.title: Sasol's Wartime Windfall Revives Debate Over Coal's Future
events.summary: Sasol Ltd., the world's largest producer of fuel from coal, is experiencing a windfall due to surging fuel prices from the Iran war, which is also helping to shield South Africa from supply shocks. CEO Simon Baloyi has focused on coal-to-liquids fuel output and crude refining, leading to an expected EBITDA of up to 62 billion rand ($3.8 billion) for the year ended June 30. Despite environmental concerns about Sasol being a major greenhouse gas emitter, the company is pursuing emissions reductions and renewable energy projects.

events.title: CHEVRON CORP : TD COWEN RAISES TARGET PRICE TO $205 FROM $200
events.summary: TD COWEN has raised its target price for Chevron Corp (CVX.N) to $205 from $200. This update indicates a more optimistic outlook from the analyst firm regarding Chevron's stock performance. The report was published by Reuters.

events.title: Parallel Advisors LLC Increases Stake in ExxonMobil Corporation $XOM
events.summary: Parallel Advisors LLC increased its stake in ExxonMobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) by 9.5% in the first quarter, now holding 84,848 shares valued at $14.4 million. Despite the company reporting higher-than-expected revenue but missing earnings estimates, analysts maintain a "Hold" rating with a consensus price target of $162.95. ExxonMobil also declared a quarterly dividend of $1.03, resulting in a 2.7% yield.

events.title: TD Cowen Adjusts Price Target on Chevron to $205 From $200, Maintains Hold Rating
events.summary: TD Cowen has increased its price target for Chevron (CVX) to $205 from $200, while reiterating a Hold rating on the stock. This adjustment reflects a modest upward revision in the analyst's valuation for the integrated oil and gas group. The article also provides a company profile for Chevron, detailing its business segments, employee count, and upcoming ex-dividend date.

events.title: Trucking Efficiency Roundup: Natural gas, energy tracking, and fueling services are reshaping fleet operations
events.summary: This article highlights how trucking fleets are improving operations through the adoption of natural gas, advanced energy management systems for EVs, and expanded fueling services. Clean Energy is growing its CNG network to support Cummins X15N natural gas trucks, while Teletrac Navman's Energy Hub offers unified data for mixed-energy fleets. Orbit Fuels is expanding its diesel and DEF fueling services to reduce fleet downtime.

events.title: Eni approves final investment decision for Cronos deepwater gas field, Cyprus' first hydrocarbon development
events.summary: Eni SpA has approved the final investment decision for the Cronos deepwater gas field offshore Cyprus, marking the nation's first hydrocarbon project. Collaborating with TotalEnergies, the development aims for first gas production by 2028, with gas being processed in Egypt due to Cyprus' lack of LNG infrastructure. This project is expected to contribute significantly to both Eni's and TotalEnergies' LNG portfolio targets, positioning Cyprus as a key player in the Eastern Mediterranean gas strategy.

events.title: New Front End Attachments for Deere Tractors
events.summary: Ignite Attachments has expanded its product line to include new buckets and pallet fork frames designed specifically for John Deere compact tractors using the hook-and-pin loader interface. This expansion addresses a previous lack of aftermarket options for John Deere owners, offering more choices, value, and assured compatibility. The new attachments, including various bucket sizes and a 2,500-pound capacity pallet fork frame, aim to improve performance and provide long-term value for farm, landscape, and property maintenance tasks.

events.title: Sasol’s wartime windfall revives debate over coal’s future
events.summary: Sasol Ltd., the world’s largest producer of fuel from coal, is experiencing a wartime windfall due to surging fuel prices caused by the Iran war, while also bolstering South Africa's energy security. CEO Simon Baloyi has focused on increasing coal-to-liquids fuel output and production from its crude refinery, leading to a projected EBITDA increase. This situation highlights the ongoing debate about the long-term sustainability of the business given its significant greenhouse gas emissions versus its strategic importance and efforts to reduce carbon intensity.

events.title: SandRidge Energy, Inc. Announces Financial and Operating Results for the Three and Six-Month Periods Ended June 30, 2026 and Declares Dividend of $0.13 per Share
events.summary: SandRidge Energy, Inc. announced its financial and operating results for the three and six-month periods ended June 30, 2026, including a dividend declaration of $0.13 per share. The company reported increased production and revenues, driven by its Cherokee development program and higher commodity prices. SandRidge also detailed its liquidity, capital structure, and ongoing commitment to ESG principles, and anticipates closing a significant acquisition in the Cherokee Play in Q3 2026.

events.title: Envision and Sasol Partner to Advance Green Hydrogen Hub in South Africa
events.summary: Chinese clean energy firm Envision Energy and South African petrochemicals giant Sasol have initiated a design study to assess a green hydrogen system at Sasol's Sasolburg operations. This collaboration, announced during South Africa's Energy Investment Conference in China, aims to integrate renewable power, battery energy storage, and electrolyzers for optimized green hydrogen production. The partnership supports South Africa's goal to become a green hydrogen exporter and Sasol's strategy to decarbonize its business using existing industrial infrastructure.

events.title: Phillips 66 reports nearly 20 times-higher quarter-over-quarter earnings
events.summary: Phillips 66 reported a significant surge in its second-quarter 2026 earnings, reaching $3.8 billion, a near 20-fold increase from the previous quarter. This boost was driven by higher margins and improved asset utilization across its refining, midstream, and chemical segments, with refining utilization rates at 96%. The company also highlighted project updates, including the full commissioning of its Dos Picos II natural gas processing plant and continued progress on major polymer projects.

events.title: ConocoPhillips set to report earnings amid oil volatility By Investing.com
events.summary: ConocoPhillips is anticipated to announce strong second-quarter earnings, with analysts expecting significant sequential profit growth despite recent drops in crude oil prices. The company is forecast to report $2.88 per share on $18.69 billion in revenue, driven by increased production and improved price realizations when oil prices surged above $120 per barrel. Investors will be closely watching production performance, adherence to shareholder return targets amidst oil price volatility, and the company's long-term strategy for its Alaska operations, particularly the Willow project.

events.title: ConocoPhillips set to report earnings amid oil volatility
events.summary: ConocoPhillips is preparing to release its second-quarter earnings, with analysts anticipating a significant profit increase despite recent drops in crude oil prices. The company is expected to report $2.88 per share on $18.69 billion in revenue, driven by higher production and improved realizations when oil prices were elevated. The company's U.S. ADR and European listings both show significant year-to-date gains and trade near 52-week highs, supported by strong profitability metrics and strategic positioning in the global energy market, including involvement in electric mobility solutions. Geopolitical tensions and the company's ability to navigate complex supply routes further bolster its valuation.

events.title: Is ConocoPhillips Stock a Buy as Growth Meets a Premium Valuation?
events.summary: ConocoPhillips (COP) exhibits strong growth drivers, including its Lower 48 inventory, expanding LNG exposure, and the multi-year Willow project in Alaska. However, its valuation is considered premium compared to industry benchmarks, leading to a debate between price and execution. Despite strong earnings support and projected growth, the stock currently holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) due to commodity sensitivity, regional gas pricing weaknesses, and major project risks.

events.title: Bank of New York Mellon Corp Buys Shares of 14,346,731 Chevron Corporation $CVX
events.summary: Bank of New York Mellon Corp has acquired a significant new position in Chevron Corporation, purchasing over 14 million shares valued at approximately $2.37 billion during the second quarter. This move makes them a substantial institutional investor in the oil and gas giant. The article also details other institutional investor activities, Chevron's financial performance, dividend announcements, and recent insider trading, alongside analyst ratings and key news impacting the company.

events.title: Jennison Associates LLC Trims Stake in AbbVie Inc. $ABBV
events.summary: Jennison Associates LLC significantly reduced its stake in AbbVie Inc. by 36.1% in the second quarter, selling 383,188 shares, but still holds 679,544 shares valued at $171 million. Despite this, institutional investors collectively own 70.23% of ABBV, and analysts generally maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $275.95. Recent developments include AbbVie exceeding earnings expectations, a consistent quarterly dividend, and a new 52-week high, though an executive's recent $8.18 million share sale and increased leverage from an acquisition are noted as negative sentiments.

events.title: Notis McConarty Edward Purchases New Position in Chevron Corporation $CVX
events.summary: Notis McConarty Edward has acquired a new position in Chevron Corporation, purchasing 12,456 shares valued at approximately $2.065 million during the second quarter. This move is part of broader institutional investor activity, with several major firms like BlackRock, State Street Corp, and Berkshire Hathaway Inc. also adjusting their stakes in Chevron. The article also details recent insider transactions, analyst ratings, and Chevron's strong financial performance, including a recent dividend announcement and exceeding earnings expectations.

events.title: Trillium Asset Management LLC Purchases New Shares in Ormat Technologies, Inc. $ORA
events.summary: Trillium Asset Management LLC has acquired a new stake of 147,901 shares in Ormat Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:ORA) during the second quarter, valued at approximately $16.1 million. This makes Trillium Asset Management LLC the owner of 0.24% of Ormat Technologies' stock. Ormat Technologies recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates, and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.12 per share.

events.title: Tejara Capital Ltd Reduces Stock Position in SLB Limited $SLB
events.summary: Tejara Capital Ltd significantly reduced its stake in SLB Limited by 78.9% in the second quarter, now holding 21,400 shares valued at $995,000. Despite this reduction, other institutional investors have recently bought into SLB, with hedge funds and institutional investors owning 81.99% of the company's stock. SLB reported strong earnings, beating analyst estimates, and announced a quarterly dividend, while analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating with a target price of $61.35.

events.title: Hess Corporation stock benefits as Chevron highlights accelerated Hess synergies
events.summary: Hess Corporation's stock performance is now closely linked to Chevron's integration of Hess's assets, with Chevron reporting $1.5 billion in synergies realized six months ahead of schedule. This acceleration, alongside a 5% increase in global upstream production and record U.S. output, demonstrates the strategic value and successful integration of Hess's portfolio into Chevron's operations. The strong financial results, including significant free cash flow and debt reduction, benefit former Hess shareholders who received Chevron stock.

events.title: PermRock Royalty Trust Declares Monthly Cash Distribution
events.summary: PermRock Royalty Trust (PRT) has declared a monthly cash distribution of $0.021782 per Trust Unit, totaling $265,001.53, based on June 2026 production. This distribution will be paid on September 15, 2026, to unitholders of record as of August 31, 2026. The announcement details underlying oil and natural gas sales volumes, average wellhead prices, and changes in cash receipts and operating expenses compared to the prior month.

events.title: The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD) Announces Quarterly Dividend of $2.33
events.summary: The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD) has declared a quarterly dividend of $2.33 per share, payable on September 17th to shareholders of record on September 3rd. This dividend represents an annualized yield of approximately 2.8% and marks the 16th consecutive year of dividend increases for the company. Home Depot's latest quarterly results surpassed analyst expectations, with EPS of $4.92 and revenue of $47.86 billion, though shares opened down 2.9% following the announcement.

events.title: Gorgon stage three tie-back gets first TechnipFMC Subsea 2.0 tree
events.summary: TechnipFMC has delivered its first 7-inch Subsea 2.0 horizontal christmas tree to Chevron Australia for the Gorgon stage three (GS3) offshore project. This system, known as XT #1, was assembled in Malaysia and is the first build of this specific Subsea 2.0 configuration. The GS3 project will connect the Geryon and Eurytion natural gas fields to existing processing facilities and represents the first in a series of planned subsea tie-back projects.

events.title: ConocoPhillips (COP) Beats Earnings and Names New CEO While Exxon Mobil (XOM)’s Record Profit Falls Short
events.summary: ConocoPhillips (COP) reported its best quarterly results since 2022, with adjusted profit beating Wall Street expectations, and announced CFO Andy O'Brien will succeed Ryan Lance as CEO. In contrast, Exxon Mobil (XOM) posted its highest quarterly profit in four years but still missed per-share estimates, causing its shares to dip. The article highlights that merely improving past performance isn't always enough to satisfy today's investors, as evidenced by the differing market reactions to COP's beat and XOM's record profit.

events.title: UPDATE: Erie oil and gas drilling deal falls apart after SM Energy backs out
events.summary: The town of Erie announced that SM Energy has withdrawn from a multimillion-dollar mineral rights deal for the Draco pad, following significant community pushback. Residents had raised concerns about health and safety impacts from drilling near neighborhoods, leading to a referendum effort. Erie will temporarily retain ownership of its mineral rights and is evaluating the implications of the canceled agreement.

events.summary: ConocoPhillips (COP) announced strong quarterly results, its best since 2022, exceeding analyst expectations, and named CFO Andy O'Brien as the new CEO. In contrast, Exxon Mobil (XOM) posted its highest profit in four years but still fell short of Wall Street estimates, causing its shares to drop. The article highlights that while ConocoPhillips is well-positioned, Exxon's performance indicates that past improvements aren't always enough to satisfy current investors.

events.title: UGI (UGI) Closed 9.4% Higher on a Reported KKR Bid. Does $42.50 Fully Value Its AI-Power Opportunity?
events.summary: UGI Corporation (UGI) shares closed 9.4% higher after The Wall Street Journal reported a KKR & Co. Inc. bid of $9 billion, or $42.50 per share. This offer represents a 21.1% premium but is still below the reported bid price, raising questions about whether it fully values UGI's potential in supplying power to AI data centers. The article discusses both the bull case for accepting the immediate premium and the bear case concerning deal risks and the future growth opportunities in AI infrastructure.

events.title: Toll Brothers (TOL) Beat Estimates. Can Affluent Buyers Offset Falling Home Deliveries?
events.summary: Toll Brothers (TOL) beat fiscal third-quarter estimates despite a 9.7% decline in total revenue and fewer home deliveries. The company's focus on affluent buyers, who often pay in cash or with substantial down payments, is helping to mitigate the impact of elevated mortgage rates and a contracting market. However, falling profit margins and declining sales productivity per community indicate that even affluent demand has limits in fully offsetting shrinking volumes.

events.title: TXO Partners Eyes Higher 2027 Distributions as Williston Drilling Gains Momentum
events.summary: TXO Partners is focusing on generating higher cash distributions by 2027, driven by a strategic shift towards longer-lateral horizontal drilling in the Williston Basin. The company plans to maintain disciplined capital spending and leverage, with an aim to increase distributions after 2026, while selectively investing across its Permian, San Juan, and Williston basin portfolios. Although the San Juan Mancos development is currently deferred due to commodity prices, TXO has invested in infrastructure for future growth and expects to hedge about 50% of its production.

events.title: ConocoPhillips names CFO Andy O'Brien as new CEO, tasked with completing Alaska's Willow oil project and delivering $7 billion cash flow target by 2029
events.summary: ConocoPhillips has appointed CFO Andy O'Brien as its new CEO, effective September 1, succeeding Ryan Lance, who will become executive chairman. O'Brien inherits the challenging goal of achieving a $7 billion free cash flow target by 2029, largely dependent on the completion of the Willow oil project in Alaska, which has seen cost increases and faces significant execution risks. Despite the company's recent share underperformance and internal cost-cutting measures, O'Brien has affirmed his commitment to the existing strategic plan.

events.title: Canada Consumer Spending to Slow on Tepid Hiring, Sticky Gas Prices -- Market Talk
events.summary: Economists predict a deceleration in Canadian consumer spending due to a cooling labor market and persistent high gasoline prices. This slowdown is expected to temper economic growth in the second half of the year, although robust tourism and services sectors offer some counterbalance.

events.title: BP Shares Rise Ahead of Rivals as Brent Surge Fuels Debt Recovery
events.summary: BP's shares rose 5.09% this week, outperforming rivals, driven by a 6.39% surge in Brent crude prices. This performance suggests investors believe higher oil prices will accelerate BP's debt reduction efforts. The company reported strong Q2 2026 results with a significant increase in operating cash flow and a 12.1% decrease in net debt, along with a dividend increase.

events.title: Hess Corporation stock holds steady as investors watch post-merger positioning
events.summary: Hess Corporation's stock is stable in late August 2026 as investors evaluate its integration into Chevron and the performance of Hess Midstream. The article highlights that Hess Midstream is now the primary vehicle for investors to gain exposure to Hess's legacy Bakken assets, emphasizing its strong cash flow and dividend potential. Director-level stock sales in Chevron by a former Hess insider are also being closely watched for insights into post-merger alignment.

events.title: VanEck Oil Refiners ETF (NYSE:CRAK) Stock Quote
events.summary: This article provides a stock quote for the VanEck Oil Refiners ETF (NYSE: CRAK), detailing its current price, trading volume, and performance metrics. It also includes a compilation of recent news headlines related to the oil refining sector and its constituent companies like Valero, Phillips 66, and Marathon Petroleum, highlighting factors influencing their stock performance. The article lists frequently asked questions about the ETF, including its trading exchange, ticker symbol, and market capitalization.

events.title: argenx SE (ARGX) Won Its Phase 3 Myositis Trial. How Much Does the Subgroup Miss Matter?
events.summary: argenx SE's VYVGART Hytrulo showed positive results in its Phase 3 ALKIVIA trial for immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy (IMNM), a significant win as there's no approved treatment for IMNM. However, the trial's dermatomyositis subgroup, which represents a larger patient population, did not achieve statistical significance, raising questions about the drug's full market potential and regulatory path. Despite this, the established drug's expansion into IMNM is seen as a credible opportunity.

events.summary: This content provides a licensable picture of a Chevron gas station in Encinitas, California. The image was taken on October 23, 2023, following Chevron Corp's announcement to acquire Hess Corp in a $53 billion all-stock deal. events.title: Director's Stock Purchase Signals Confidence in Alpha Metallurgical Resources
events.summary: Kenneth S. Courtis, a director at Alpha Metallurgical Resources (AMR), recently purchased 15,000 shares for $2.9 million, significantly increasing his holdings and signaling strong confidence in the company despite its recent net loss and industry challenges. This insider buying is viewed as a bullish indicator, suggesting anticipated future price increases. AMR, a metallurgical coal supplier, faces competitive pressures from alternative energy sources but has shown a 39% total return over the past year.

events.title: Wall Street's Most Accurate Analysts Weigh In On 3 Energy Stocks With Over 3% Dividend Yields
events.summary: The article highlights three energy stocks—Patterson-UTI Energy (PTEN), Chevron Corp (CVX), and Chord Energy Corp (CHRD)—that offer dividend yields over 3%. It provides recent analyst ratings and price target adjustments from highly accurate Wall Street analysts for each stock, along with brief updates on their latest quarterly earnings. The piece suggests that dividend-yielding stocks are attractive during market turbulence due to their high free cash flows and consistent shareholder rewards.

events.title: Deutsche Bank AG Makes New Investment in TransMedics Group, Inc. $TMDX
events.summary: Deutsche Bank AG has acquired a new stake in TransMedics Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:TMDX), purchasing 217,031 shares valued at approximately $14.415 million, representing about 0.63% of the company. Other institutional investors have also adjusted their positions in TMDX, with 99.67% of the stock owned by hedge funds and institutions. The article also notes recent stock performance, earnings results where the company missed EPS estimates but beat revenue expectations, and a recent insider stock sale.

events.title: Chevron Expands Base Oils Network With New Partnerships
events.summary: Chevron is expanding its North American base oils distribution network through new agreements with HF Sinclair Corporation's Lubricants & Specialties segment and Renkert Oil. HF Sinclair will be the exclusive distributor of Group II base oils in Canada and have non-exclusive rights in parts of the U.S. from May 1, 2027, while Renkert Oil continues its distribution across North America and Europe. This expansion aims to enhance distribution capabilities and ensure reliable product and service for customers.

events.title: Korea Investment CORP Takes $35.82 Million Position in Targa Resources, Inc. $TRGP
events.summary: Korea Investment CORP has acquired a new stake in Targa Resources, Inc. (NYSE:TRGP), purchasing 133,597 shares valued at approximately $35.82 million during the second quarter. This move makes Korea Investment CORP a 0.06% owner of the pipeline company. Other institutional investors have also adjusted their holdings in TRGP, which currently holds a "Buy" rating from analysts with an average target price of $297.18.

events.title: US Energy Stocks Retail Investors Are Watching As Oil Prices And Yields Climb
events.summary: Amid rising oil prices and high Treasury yields, this article identifies three US energy stocks that retail investors are monitoring. It highlights Ovintiv (OVV), Magnolia Oil & Gas (MGY), and Select Water Solutions (WTTR), detailing their operations, market positions, and potential risks and rewards. The article emphasizes how these companies are positioned to benefit from current market conditions while also facing specific industry challenges.

events.title: Sunoco LP Partners with Verde Marine Energy for ARA and UK Bunker Supply - News and Statistics
events.summary: Sunoco LP, through its subsidiary Sunoco Marine Ltd, has partnered with Verde Marine Energy B.V. (VME) to expand its marine fuel operations into the ARA (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Antwerp) and UK bunker markets. This collaboration leverages Sunoco's North American and Caribbean presence with Verde's Northern European expertise, aiming to broaden commercial footprints and introduce new products globally. The partnership, set to launch operations on October 1, 2026, builds on a prior successful venture and seeks to enhance their service portfolio with additional barges, new fuel types, and more ports.

events.title: HF Sinclair posts a profit and closes its only Canadian lubricant (base oil) refinery. Not because of no profits, but it is not worth doing business with Net Zero Leadership.
events.summary: HF Sinclair (NYSE: DINO) has announced the closure of its sole Canadian base oil refinery in Mississauga, Ontario, despite reporting its strongest quarterly profits in years, including a highly profitable lubricants segment. This decision aligns with the company's shift towards a capital-light model and is attributed to the increasing costs and risks associated with Canada's aggressive Net Zero-aligned policies, mirroring similar industry exits in California due to stringent climate regulations. Critics argue that this move compromises Canadian energy security and self-sufficiency in critical industrial inputs.

events.title: Exxon Mobil stock steadies after Guyana fire disruption as earnings power stays in focus
events.summary: Exxon Mobil's stock remains near recent highs despite a temporary halt in Guyana operations due to a fire, as strong second-quarter production and a positive 2026 revenue consensus reassure investors. The company's diversified production across the Americas, including record U.S. output, is helping to mitigate the impact of localized disruptions. Analysts maintain a cautiously positive stance, with the stock's valuation anchored by continued strong execution on key projects and a supportive commodity environment.

events.title: TotalEnergies’ (TTE FP) CEO says the Co. will continue investing across all forms of energy to pursue what he calls “energy abundance; rude oil is moving through the Strait of Hormuz today “very quietly
events.summary: The CEO of TotalEnergies (TTE FP) stated the company will continue investing in all forms of energy to achieve "energy abundance," and noted that oil is moving "very quietly" through the Strait of Hormuz. This perspective is significant due to TotalEnergies' direct exposure to the Middle East, suggesting that current supply disruption premia may lack physical basis. The company's stance aligns with European majors defending hydrocarbon investment alongside low-carbon spending.

events.title: Morgan Stanley’s Wilson Sees Higher Oil as Key Risk for Equities
events.summary: Morgan Stanley's Michael Wilson views a renewed spike in oil prices as the primary risk for US equities, suggesting that energy shares can hedge portfolios. He warns that higher oil prices could elevate yields, prompting the Federal Reserve to intervene, potentially causing market instability. Wilson also reiterates his preference for "quality stocks" with stable earnings and efficient operations, which he believes offer better protection than international peers.

events.title: Hess Corporation stock holds steady as investors focus on Guyana growth
events.summary: Hess Corporation's stock performance is currently driven by its significant growth projects in Guyana and the Bakken shale, amidst the broader volatility of global oil markets. The company's strategic focus on stable jurisdictions in the Americas, particularly Guyana's offshore production, positions it favorably as international oil companies shift investments away from higher-risk regions. Investors are keenly watching Hess's project timelines, production volumes, and capital spending, as its diversified asset base helps to smooth revenue volatility.

events.title: Oil tightens as Morgan Stanley sees Brent hitting $100 (CL1:COM:Commodity)
events.summary: Morgan Stanley has raised its Brent crude forecast, predicting it will hit $100 per barrel due to tightening oil markets, declining supply, and inventory draws. The investment bank also extended its timeline for the recovery of Middle East oil supplies. Brent crude was trading around $92 a barrel at the time of the report.

events.title: Equinor, Aker BP and Vaar to cooperate on Norway frontier oil exploration
events.summary: Equinor, Aker BP, and Vaar Energi are partnering to explore less-explored areas of Norway's continental shelf, aiming for significant new oil and gas discoveries. This collaboration seeks to mitigate the higher risks associated with frontier exploration by combining expertise, data, and technology. The companies plan to test 20-25 exploration opportunities over the next 4-5 years, with an estimated annual drilling cost of $750 million starting in 2028, primarily focusing on Haltenbanken in the Norwegian Sea.

events.title: Frontline Approaches 14-Year Peak as Oil Climbs 6% on the Week
events.summary: Frontline shares are nearing a 14-year high, trading just 3.3% below their 52-week peak, driven by a 6% weekly surge in oil prices and tightening tanker availability due to Strait of Hormuz shipping constraints. Unlike major integrated oil producers like Exxon and Chevron, Frontline provides more direct exposure to these market dynamics, resulting in a 5.97% stock increase last week. The company, set to announce Q2 results on August 31, is operating on solid financial ground, having reported strong Q1 adjusted earnings and a dividend in line with EPS.

events.title: Is Guyana Becoming an Even Bigger Cash Flow Engine for ExxonMobil?
events.summary: ExxonMobil is poised for significant cash flow growth from its Guyana operations, expecting free cash flow in 2030 to be double the 2025 level due to accelerated investment recovery and higher production. The company is expanding its FPSO capacity, with a fifth FPSO starting in late 2026 and a ninth planned for 2031, while also identifying new opportunities through AI-powered exploration. This expansion also benefits Chevron, with its stake in the Stabroek Block, and TechnipFMC, through sustained demand for its subsea services.

events.title: Diana Shipping (DSX) & Genco Shipping (GNK): A Nearly Year-Long Shipping Takeover Fight Just Ended. Here’s Who Blinked
events.summary: Diana Shipping Inc. (DSX) has withdrawn its nearly year-long takeover bid for Genco Shipping & Trading Limited (GNK), stating Genco's demands were unrealistic for any credible acquirer. This ends a protracted fight in the shipping industry, leaving Diana as Genco's largest shareholder. Genco's shares fell slightly on the news, as the company now needs to justify its valuation without the takeover premium.

events.title: Cost to Ship a VLCC Through Hormuz Hits $20 Million, TotalEnergies CEO Says
events.summary: TotalEnergies CEO Patrick Pouyanne stated that shipping oil on a supertanker through the Strait of Hormuz costs around $20 million, translating to about $10 a barrel. This high freight cost creates significant profit margins for traders and shipowners, as producers sell oil inside the Persian Gulf at $50-$60 per barrel due to ongoing conflict. Despite fears of price surges, increased oil flows through Hormuz have kept benchmark Brent futures below $100, while fuel markets remain tight due to attacks on Russian refineries.

events.title: Chevron vs. Shell: Which Energy Major Offers a Better Bet?
events.summary: This article compares two energy giants, Chevron (CVX) and Shell (SHEL), to determine which offers a better investment. While both companies are strong, Chevron is highlighted for its clearer near-term production momentum, faster realized synergies, deeper Guyana exposure, and a differentiated contracted-power opportunity, making it a more compelling choice for sustained production growth and cash flow strength. Shell, despite a more discounted valuation and attractive LNG business, faces integration risks and Middle East exposure.

events.title: $20 million: The cost of shipping oil through Strait of Hormuz, TotalEnergies CEO says
events.summary: The CEO of TotalEnergies, Patrick Pouyanne, revealed that shipping oil through the Strait of Hormuz now costs $20 million per supertanker. This high cost creates significant margins for traders and shipowners, but Middle Eastern producers are offering sharp discounts on crude to maintain market access. While these shipments keep global crude prices below $100, the fuel markets remain tight due to increased transportation costs for refined products and attacks on Russian refineries.

events.title: ExxonMobil vs. Chevron: We Compared 10 Years of Dividend Growth And Here’s the Winner
events.summary: This article compares the dividend growth of ExxonMobil (XOM) and Chevron (CVX) over the past decade, highlighting their differing strategies and dividend durability. While ExxonMobil boasts a longer streak of consecutive annual dividend increases, Chevron offers a higher current yield and is exploring new revenue streams through a deal with Microsoft. The author ultimately leans towards ExxonMobil for dividend durability but acknowledges Chevron's appeal for higher current income.

events.title: ExxonMobil vs. Chevron: We Compared 10 Years of Dividend Growth And Here's the Winner
events.summary: This article compares the dividend growth of ExxonMobil (XOM) and Chevron (CVX) over the past decade, highlighting their differing strategies. While ExxonMobil boasts a longer streak of consecutive dividend increases due to organic growth, Chevron offers a higher current yield and is diversifying its revenue through a significant deal with Microsoft for AI data centers. The author leans towards ExxonMobil for dividend durability but finds Chevron more interesting for current income and optionality.

events.title: ICYMI - Morgan Stanley lifts Brent forecast to $100 as oil market tightens
events.summary: Morgan Stanley has significantly increased its Brent crude forecasts, anticipating a peak of $100 in Q4 2026 due to a slower-than-expected recovery in Middle East supply and tightening market conditions. The bank's strategist, Mike Wilson, also identified a renewed oil spike as the biggest risk to US stocks, recommending energy shares as a portfolio hedge. The upgraded outlook reflects falling oil inventories and a wide gap between crude and refined product prices, indicating constrained refining capacity.

events.title: HF Sinclair deepens base oil reach with new supply ties
events.summary: HF Sinclair has announced new long-term base oil supply agreements with SK Enmove and Chevron, expanding its access to Group II and Group III products across North America. This move is part of a strategy to reshape its Lubricants & Specialties business, diversify its sourcing, and transition away from its Mississauga refining assets by late 2027. The company aims to provide a more resilient supply chain and broader product portfolio to its customers.

events.title: Woodside says Scarborough project is 98% complete, targets first LNG in Q4 2026
events.summary: Woodside Energy Group reported a strong half-year performance for H1 2026, with net profit after tax rising 27% to $1,672 million and operating revenue up 13% to $7,446 million. The company announced that its Scarborough Energy Project is 98% complete and on track to deliver its first LNG cargo in Q4 2026, while also progressing other major projects like Trion (64% complete) and Louisiana LNG (28% complete). Woodside maintained high operational reliability across its LNG facilities and declared an interim dividend of 57 US cents per share.

events.title: Resilient Exxon Mobil stock trades close to highs as Q2 2026 cash flow and Guyana project drive the
events.summary: Exxon Mobil stock is trading near its recent highs, driven by strong Q2 2026 earnings, robust cash generation, and promising long-term projects in Guyana and advanced products. Despite a slight earnings miss and short-term operational disruptions, investor confidence remains high, focusing on the company's overall profitability and cash flow. The stock's performance and valuation reflect strong year-to-date gains, with analysts closely watching future growth in both upstream and specialty product segments.

events.title: Zacks Market Edge Highlights: ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, Chevron
events.summary: Zacks Market Edge podcast host Tracey Ryniec discusses the investment opportunities in "Big Oil" companies like ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, and Chevron, especially in the context of the ongoing Iran War. The article highlights how these integrated energy companies have generated massive free cash flows due to elevated refining margins, exacerbated by drone strikes on Russian refineries. It recommends these three companies as "buys" based on their financial performance, shareholder-friendly policies, and attractive valuations.

events.title: Zacks Market Edge Highlights: ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, Chevron
