events.title: JPMorgan, Santander lead financing of up to US$15 billion for LNG Project
events.summary: JPMorgan Chase and Banco Santander are leading the financing efforts for the Argentina LNG project, aiming to secure US$14 billion to US$15 billion of the total US$24 billion cost. This unprecedented project, a venture between YPF SA, Eni SpA, and XRG, seeks to liquefy and export Argentina's shale gas, with a final investment decision expected in late November. The initiative highlights a revival in Argentina's energy sector under President Javier Milei's free-market reforms.

events.title: Cenovus vs. Phillips 66: Which Energy Stock Is the Better Buy?
events.summary: This article compares Cenovus Energy (CVE) and Phillips 66 (PSX), two major energy companies, to determine which offers a better investment opportunity. Cenovus, an integrated Canadian energy company, is favored due to its growing oil sands production, improved operating efficiency, stronger balance sheet, and a more attractive valuation compared to Phillips 66, a diversified energy company focusing on refining, midstream, and renewables. While both companies face risks from commodity price volatility and geopolitical tensions, Cenovus's lower valuation and production momentum present a more favorable risk-reward profile.

events.title: Vivakor raises 2026 crude oil marketing outlook to $3.5 billion
events.summary: Vivakor Inc. has increased its 2026 Supply & Trading outlook to $3.5 billion in annualized commercial activity, up from its current level of $2.35 billion. This revised forecast is driven by the expansion of its commercial pipeline and dynamic global crude oil market conditions, including heightened activity during geopolitical volatility in the Middle East. The company aims for continued growth through increased physical crude oil volumes and expanded commercial relationships, while noting that its gross profit will be a small percentage of the total contract value.

events.title: Opera (OPRA) Moved Its Earnings Forward. Can AI Browser Browser Growth Produce Another Guidance Increase?
events.summary: Opera Limited (OPRA) moved its Q2 earnings release forward, sparking speculation about another potential guidance increase due to strong Q1 results and rapid adoption in Western markets, especially with its AI browser features. The article discusses both bullish prospects, citing user growth, improved economics, and cash flow, and bearish concerns, highlighting the continued reliance on advertising and search revenue and intense competition in the browser market. The upcoming earnings will clarify if AI engagement is driving sustainable growth or if the company remains heavily dependent on ad partners.

events.title: Cenovus vs. Phillips 66: Which Energy Stock Is the Better Buy?
events.summary: This article compares Cenovus Energy Inc. (CVE) and Phillips 66 (PSX), two energy companies with different operating profiles, to determine which offers a better investment opportunity. While both have seen significant stock price surges, Cenovus is highlighted for its discounted valuation, growing oil sands production, improved operating efficiency, and stronger balance sheet, despite commodity price uncertainties. Phillips 66, a more diversified company, is noted for its midstream projects but has a higher valuation.

events.title: Levi Strauss & Co., Ford, ExxonMobil, PSEG, eBay Named Among Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Companies 2026
events.summary: Newsweek has released its second annual "America's Greatest Companies 2026" ranking, recognizing 650 leading U.S. publicly listed companies. The ranking, developed with Plant-A Insights Group, evaluates companies on financial strength, employer performance, innovation, and environmental sustainability. Companies like Levi Strauss & Co., Ford, ExxonMobil, PSEG, and eBay received five-star recognition for demonstrating resilience, responsible leadership, investment in their workforces, and commitment to sustainable growth.

events.title: Brazil approves LNG joint venture between YPF, Eni and XRG
events.summary: Brazil's antitrust authority, Cade, has approved a joint venture between Argentina’s YPF, Eni Argentina, and XRG (a subsidiary of ADNOC) for a large-scale integrated liquefied natural gas (LNG) project in Argentina. The project will involve dedicated upstream production, pipeline transportation, and offshore liquefaction using two floating liquefaction units (FLNGs) off the coast of Sierra Grande, with the first unit expected to begin operations in 2030. Cade's approval was granted after assessing the companies' operations in Brazil and determining that their market shares were below thresholds that would indicate a dominant position or risk of market foreclosure.

events.title: Performance Food (PFGC) Grew Sales 6.4% as Product Inflation Hit 4.7%. How Much Growth Was Real?
events.summary: Performance Food Group (PFGC) reported a 6.4% increase in sales for its fiscal fourth quarter, driven by a 4.7% product cost inflation and a 3.5% total case volume increase. While net income rose significantly, adjusted diluted EPS showed more modest growth due to higher operating costs. The article questions the real growth beyond inflation, highlighting strong independent foodservice volume but also noting cost pressures on earnings leverage.

events.title: Home Depot (HD) Beat Q2 Estimates. What Did the $685M Tariff Refund Change?
events.summary: Home Depot reported stronger-than-expected fiscal second-quarter results, with sales increasing 5.7% to $47.86 billion and adjusted EPS exceeding estimates. The company received a significant $685 million tariff refund, which materially benefited earnings and contributed to a higher gross margin, though other unplanned costs somewhat offset the net benefit. While Pro-led sales showed strength, overall comparable transactions declined, suggesting that a broad housing market recovery has not yet materialized, and the financial performance relies heavily on execution and market-share gains rather than a fundamental turnaround in housing.

events.title: Woodside Retreats on Clean Energy, Doubles Down on LNG
events.summary: Australia's largest oil and gas producer, Woodside Energy Group Ltd., is scaling back its clean energy investments and emissions-abatement targets to prioritize fossil fuels. The company cites a "change in customer appetite" and delays in policy frameworks as reasons for its shift, which includes abandoning a $5 billion clean-energy spending plan by 2030. This strategic pivot comes as Woodside reports increased earnings due to higher oil and LNG prices, despite a drop in production.

events.title: BILL (BILL) Expanded Non-GAAP Operating Profit While Reported Business Metric Fell. Has its Efficiency Push Gone Too Far?
events.summary: BILL Holdings, Inc. (BILL) reported stronger revenue and significantly higher non-GAAP operating profit for fiscal 2026, despite a decline in the overall number of businesses using its solutions. While core revenue, payment volume, transactions, and AI adoption grew, the company experienced a wider GAAP operating loss and slower core customer additions, raising questions about whether its efficiency drive has impacted growth. The article suggests that if core customer additions recover, the shares could be promising, but also points to other AI stocks with potentially greater upside and less risk.

events.title: Enovix (ENVX) Plans to Double Drone Battery Capacity. Is a $183M Pipeline Enough to Justify the Expansion?
events.summary: Enovix Corporation (ENVX) announced plans to double its drone battery production capacity in South Korea by mid-2027, driven by a $183 million global customer pipeline, including over $100 million in drone-related opportunities. While the expansion leverages existing facilities and the company's strong cash position, the $183 million figure represents estimated opportunities rather than firm orders, introducing timing and demand-forecasting risks. The success of this expansion hinges on converting these pipeline opportunities into binding contracts and achieving improved cash flow.

events.title: Chevron (NYSE:CVX): Can Strong Execution Offset Crude Pressure?
events.summary: This article examines how Chevron's integrated operating model can maintain resilience amidst changing crude oil conditions. It focuses on the importance of production quality, major-project execution, refining economics, and capital discipline, particularly in areas like the Permian Basin and large international developments. The piece suggests that Chevron's ability to generate durable cash flow will depend less on commodity prices and more on its operational efficiency across its diverse asset base.

events.title: Morgan Stanley Sees ExxonMobil (XOM) Breaking its Record High. Can the Oil Giant Deliver?
events.summary: Morgan Stanley has raised its price target for ExxonMobil (XOM) to $177, predicting the stock will surpass its previous record high due to strong refining margins and growth in areas like the Permian Basin and LNG. Despite falling short of Q2 earnings expectations, ExxonMobil demonstrated strong fundamentals with significant free cash flow, debt reduction, and a commitment to shareholder returns. However, the company faces geopolitical risks and potential normalization of oil prices if peace agreements are reached in the Middle East.

events.title: Chevron Plans To Blow Up Wind Turbines With Explosives This Week Near Casper
events.summary: Chevron is preparing to use explosives to remove 11 defunct wind turbines near Casper, Wyoming, later this week. The Natrona County Fire District has confirmed that controlled explosions will be used to fell portions of the turbine bases. Residents may experience brief loud noises and vibrations, and officials are urging the public to stay away from the site for safety reasons during the demolition.

events.title: ExxonMobil Set to Raise Dividend for 44th Consecutive Year
events.summary: ExxonMobil is anticipated to announce its 44th consecutive dividend increase, likely alongside its Q3 results, despite recent annual increases being modest at around 4%. The company demonstrates strong financial health with $14.5 billion in Q2 net income and robust cash flow, which covers its current $1.03 quarterly dividend nearly four times. ExxonMobil balances dividend payouts with significant investments in share repurchases and capital expenditures, while also strategically pursuing growth through acquisitions and expansion into lower-carbon businesses like its Proxxima resin systems.

events.title: YPF, Pampa, TGS, TGN, and more: Argentina's big-ticket energy projects mapped out
events.summary: Argentina's RIGI investment incentives are attracting significant interest in the oil and gas and electric power sectors, primarily from battle-hardened local and regional players. While US shale giant Continental Resources is expanding its footprint via M&A, the article highlights major projects from YPF, Pampa Energía, TGS, TGN, Tecpetrol, GeoPark, Pluspetrol, Chevron, Vista Energy, and Pan American Energy that have either secured or are seeking RIGI benefits. It also identifies potential future projects that could leverage these incentives, emphasizing the need for infrastructure to support growth, particularly in remote mining areas.

events.title: Morgan Stanley Sees ExxonMobil (XOM) Breaking its Record High. Can the Oil Giant Deliver?
events.summary: Morgan Stanley has increased its price target for ExxonMobil (XOM) to $177, maintaining an 'Overweight' rating, and expects the stock to surpass its previous record high. The firm's bullish outlook is based on updated energy sector forecasts, strong refining margins, and ExxonMobil's solid business fundamentals, including high upstream production and significant free cash flow generation. Despite strong performance, Exxon's gains have lagged pure-play refiners, and its earnings face geopolitical risks, particularly from potential normalization of crude prices and disruptions in the Middle East.

events.title: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) and Valero Energy (VLO) Have Exploded in 2026. But Barron’s Sees More Upside
events.summary: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) and Valero Energy (VLO) have seen their stock prices more than double in 2026 due to an unusual surge in global refining margins caused by capacity reductions and ongoing geopolitical conflicts. Despite investor concerns about their peak performance, Barron's suggests further upside potential for these refiners. Both companies are strategically positioned to capitalize on tight fuel markets and are focused on increasing shareholder returns, though investors are cautioned to consider the sustainability of these high margins and the significant rallies already experienced.

events.title: Exxon Mobil stock eases as oil slide tests record-high ambitions
events.summary: Exxon Mobil's stock is easing into the low $160s as a recent slide in crude oil prices offsets strong Q2 2026 cash flow. While the company generated $17.2 billion in free cash flow and returned $9.4 billion to shareholders, the drop in Brent and WTI crude has led to a 2.09% decline in its share price. Analysts have mixed views, with a consensus target around $166.10, but some bullish forecasts anticipate new record highs if favorable conditions persist.

events.title: Commerce Bank Buys Shares of 57,318 Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. $CMG
events.summary: Commerce Bank has acquired 57,318 shares of Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. (NYSE:CMG), valued at approximately $1.95 million, during the second quarter. This move highlights continued institutional interest in Chipotle, with other major investors also modifying their holdings. The article discusses recent analyst ratings, stock performance, and insider trading activity for CMG.

events.title: Elizabeth Warren Slams Trump for ‘Holding Millions’ in Oil and Gas Stocks as Iran War Sends XOM, COP, OXY Higher
events.summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren criticized former President Donald Trump, alleging he profited from the Iran war by holding significant investments in oil and gas companies. Warren claimed Trump's holdings in companies like ExxonMobil, Chevron, ConocoPhillips, and Occidental Petroleum increased in value by millions after the conflict began. A Senate Joint Economic Committee report supported these claims, indicating Trump's oil and gas stock portfolio grew by an average of 39% from January to August.

events.title: VESSEL REVIEW | Aristoklis – Dual-fuel Suezmax crude tanker joins Capital Maritime fleet
events.summary: The Capital Maritime Group's business unit, Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corporation, has taken delivery of the dual-fuel Suezmax crude oil tanker "Aristoklis" from New Times Shipbuilding in China. This vessel, designed for reduced emissions, is powered by a Hyundai-MAN B&W dual-fuel engine capable of running on LNG and features an exhaust gas aftertreatment system. It also includes shore power connection capability, meeting California Air Resources Board requirements for integration with onshore power infrastructure at the Port of Long Beach.

events.title: Quantbot Technologies LP Acquires New Position in EOG Resources, Inc. $EOG
events.summary: Quantbot Technologies LP has acquired a new position in EOG Resources, Inc., purchasing 8,899 shares valued at approximately $1,154,000 in the second quarter. Other institutional investors like Varma Mutual Pension Insurance Co, X Square Capital LLC, Westpac Banking Corp, EP Wealth Advisors LLC, and Ieq Capital LLC also adjusted their holdings in the energy exploration company. EOG Resources recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates, and announced a quarterly dividend of $1.02 per share.

events.title: Exxon Mobil stock holds in the low $160s as Guyana output and dividend strength shape the outlook
events.summary: Exxon Mobil stock is trading in the low $160s, supported by strong Q2 2026 earnings of $14.5 billion and operating cash flow of $23.6 billion. The company's investment appeal is strengthened by its growing free cash flow from Guyana, which reached 900,000 barrels per day in Q2 2026 and has recovered $55 billion in investment, alongside a 43-year track record of dividend increases. Despite recent oil price volatility, analysts maintain a "Hold" rating with an average target price of $166.10, recognizing the stock's year-to-date gain of 36.15%.

events.title: Sempra Seeks Permits for Major LNG Expansion Project in Texas
events.summary: Sempra's unit, Port Arthur LNG, has initiated the federal permitting process for a significant expansion of its LNG export operations in Southeast Texas. The proposed Port Arthur LNG North Project aims to add four liquefaction trains, increasing capacity by up to 27 million metric tons per annum, and includes new storage tanks and marine facilities. If approved, the project could begin exporting LNG by the second half of 2034, further solidifying the U.S. Gulf Coast's role as a major global LNG exporter.

events.title: CSX Honors 55 Customers for Chemical Safety Excellence
events.summary: CSX has announced the recipients of its 32nd annual Chemical Safety Excellence Awards, recognizing 55 customers for their outstanding performance in the safe transportation of hazardous materials. These awards are given to companies that shipped at least 600 carloads of hazardous materials in 2025 without a controllable release. CSX emphasizes that strong partnerships and uncompromising safety standards are crucial for rail's role as the safest mode of land transportation for hazardous materials.

events.title: Rekor Systems (NASDAQ:REKR) Penny Stock Growth Story In Focus
events.summary: Rekor Systems (NASDAQ:REKR), a penny stock, is gaining attention for its AI-powered roadway intelligence and transportation analytics. The company's growth story is centered on its ability to convert contracts, manage cash effectively, and scale its platform to meet the growing demand for digital transportation networks. Success hinges on execution, liquidity, and turning technological potential into sustainable operating economics amidst competition and financial challenges inherent to smaller tech businesses.

events.title: Intuit (INTU) is Lowering TurboTax Revenue per User to Win Customers. Can the Strategy Restore Double-Digit Growth?
events.summary: Intuit (INTU) plans to lower TurboTax revenue per user to attract and retain more customers, a strategy aimed at restoring double-digit growth after fiscal 2026 saw 14% revenue growth, but fiscal 2027 guidance predicts only 9-10% growth. While this move could leverage its Credit Karma and TurboTax Live offerings for monetization, concerns remain about customer retention and adoption of higher-value products. The company needs to prove that this pricing adjustment will lead to durable growth and not just sacrifice near-term revenue.

events.title: Canadian Oil Executives’ Stock Holdings Increased by Over $1 Billion Amid War and Wildfires
events.summary: A DeSmog analysis reveals that executives at Canadian Natural Resources Limited, Suncor, and Imperial Oil saw their personal stock holdings and options increase by over $1 billion from January to August 2026. This surge in wealth occurred during a period of rising global oil prices due to the ongoing war in Iran and devastating wildfires in Canada. The article highlights the disparity between executive windfalls and the struggles of average Canadians facing high gas prices and climate impacts, raising concerns about the oil industry's influence on government policy.

events.title: Insteel (IIIN) Is Closing a Plant Without Expecting a Revenue Hit. How Much Excess Capacity Does It Have?
events.summary: Insteel Industries (IIIN) is closing its Upper Sandusky, Ohio, welded wire reinforcement facility by October 2026, transferring production to other plants that have "ample open capacity" without expecting a revenue hit. This consolidation aims to improve margins by increasing utilization and eliminating duplicated costs, despite the company's recent acquisition strategy raising questions about excess capacity. The move is expected to incur $4.6 million in restructuring charges but is considered manageable given the company's strong balance sheet.

events.title: Sempra Plans 27 Million ton/yr Port Arthur LNG Expansion
events.summary: Sempra Infrastructure announced plans for a significant third phase expansion of its Port Arthur LNG export project. This expansion aims to add 27 million tons per year of capacity along the US Gulf Coast. The company targets completion of this massive project by the mid-2030s.

events.title: Trump’s head of offshore leasing leaving for oilfield services firm Halliburton
events.summary: Matt Giacona, the acting director of the Marine Minerals Administration and formerly the Bureau of Ocean Energy Management, is leaving the Trump administration to take a senior role in government affairs at Halliburton, an oilfield services company. Giacona's departure follows that of another senior energy staffer, Brittany Kelm, raising questions about officials moving to industries they previously regulated. He will start his new position on September 8th, with his replacement yet to be named.

events.title: Q32 Bio CFO Lee Kalowski Executes Automatic RSU Tax Withholding Share Sale
events.summary: Q32 Bio Inc.'s CFO and President, Lee Kalowski, automatically sold 3,972 shares of common stock on August 25, 2026, at $16.56 per share. This transaction was executed to fulfill tax withholding obligations stemming from the vesting of restricted stock units (RSUs), and it was not at Kalowski's discretion. Following the sale, Kalowski directly holds 138,471 shares of Q32 Bio common stock.

events.title: CSX Honors 55 Customers for Chemical Safety Excellence
events.summary: CSX announced the recipients of its 32nd annual Chemical Safety Excellence Awards, recognizing 55 customers for their outstanding performance in the safe transportation of hazardous materials in 2025. These awards honor companies that shipped at least 600 carloads of hazardous materials without a controllable release. The recognition highlights CSX's commitment to safety and strong partnerships in protecting employees and communities.

events.title: Hsbc Holdings PLC Takes $51.13 Million Position in Texas Pacific Land Corporation $TPL
events.summary: Hsbc Holdings PLC has acquired a new stake in Texas Pacific Land Corporation, purchasing 117,052 shares valued at approximately $51.13 million, representing a 0.17% ownership. Other institutional investors also adjusted their holdings, with overall institutional ownership at 59.94%. events.title: Chevron or PepsiCo: Whose Dividend Is Standing on Thinner Ice?
events.summary: This article compares the dividend safety of Chevron (CVX) and PepsiCo (PEP), highlighting that while both recently raised their dividends, they face different challenges. Chevron's dividend is seen as more secure in the near term due to strong Q2 2026 free cash flow and debt reduction, despite its cyclical nature. PepsiCo's 54-year Dividend King streak is structurally tighter, with concerns over a high debt/equity ratio, thin operating cash flow margins, and a challenging North American consumer environment affecting its earnings outlook.

events.title: CSX Honors 55 Customers for Chemical Safety Excellence
events.summary: CSX announced the recipients of its 32nd annual Chemical Safety Excellence Awards, recognizing 55 customers for their outstanding performance in safely transporting hazardous materials in 2025. These awards highlight customers who shipped at least 600 carloads of hazardous materials without any controllable releases. The company also recognized customers reaching significant safety milestones, including Kemira Water Solutions for 25 years and CHS Inc. for 15 years without a controllable hazardous materials release.

events.title: CVX, HAL Stocks Gain — Chevron, Halliburton Reportedly Eye Venezuela Oil Opportunities
events.summary: Chevron and Halliburton are reportedly pursuing opportunities in Venezuela's oil sector as the U.S. administration pushes to rebuild the country's oil industry. Chevron is nearing a deal to expand its heavy-oil field operations, while Halliburton is in talks to supply equipment to Venezuelan producers. These moves come as the Trump administration negotiates long-term oil field leases and follows a shift in Venezuela's political control.

events.title: CVX, HAL Stocks Gain — Chevron, Halliburton Reportedly Eye Venezuela Oil Opportunities
events.summary: Chevron and Halliburton are reportedly pursuing significant oil opportunities in Venezuela, with Chevron looking to add two heavy-oil fields and Halliburton discussing providing equipment to Venezuelan producers. This comes as the Trump administration negotiates a substantial stake in Venezuela's oil fields, potentially involving leases of up to 100 years, aiming to rebuild the country's oil industry following a change in its political leadership. CVX and HAL stocks saw gains on the news, with retail sentiment on Stocktwits showing mixed reactions.

events.title: Chevron nears deal to expand oil operations in Venezuela
events.summary: Chevron is reportedly in advanced talks to expand its oil operations in Venezuela by adding two new oil fields. This move comes as the Trump administration seeks to broaden its influence over Venezuela's oil sector, and other U.S. energy companies, including Halliburton, are also exploring investment opportunities in the country. Chevron is currently the only U.S. oil major active in Venezuela and accounts for about a fifth of its oil production.

events.title: Etu Energias to acquire Chevron’s Angola oil blocks
events.summary: Etu Energias announced an agreement to acquire Chevron's participating interests in Blocks 14 and 14K in Angola. This deal follows a previous development where Etu Energias matched a $260 million offer by Energean for the same Chevron assets, leading to uncertainty for Energean's acquisition plans. The Angolan-based company successfully secured the acquisition.

events.title: Chevron in Talks to Expand in Venezuela Amid Broader US Push
events.summary: Chevron Corp. is reportedly in negotiations to expand its operations in Venezuela by adding two new oil fields, as the US aims to strengthen its presence in the country's oil industry. This move comes after a change in Venezuelan leadership facilitated by the Trump administration, which is pushing for US companies to rebuild the nation's oil sector. While Venezuela possesses vast oil reserves, significant challenges such as degraded infrastructure and environmental liabilities could delay a full recovery of production.

events.title: Chevron Corp. stock outperforms competitors on strong trading day
events.summary: Chevron Corp. (CVX) saw its stock rise by 1.05% to $201.86 on Friday, outperforming the broader market which experienced a grim trading session. The S&P 500 Index fell 0.25% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.02%. Chevron Corp. closed 5.98% below its 52-week high.

events.title: The Manufacturers Life Insurance Company Purchases New Holdings in Otis Worldwide Corporation $OTIS
events.summary: The Manufacturers Life Insurance Company acquired a new stake in Otis Worldwide Corporation, purchasing 272,748 shares valued at approximately $19.5 million. This investment comes as institutional investors collectively own 88.03% of Otis. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings, exceeding revenue expectations, and reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 EPS guidance, while also declaring a quarterly dividend.

events.title: Legal & General Group Plc Buys New Position in Texas Pacific Land Corporation $TPL
events.summary: Legal & General Group Plc has acquired a new stake of 350,454 shares in Texas Pacific Land Corporation, valued at approximately $153.4 million, representing a 0.51% ownership. Institutional investors now hold 59.94% of the company's stock. Analysts currently hold a consensus "Hold" rating for Texas Pacific Land, with a target price of $639.00, following mixed sentiment from recent reports.

events.title: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Sales Jumped 8.9%, but Space NK Pressured Gross Margin. Is the Deal Paying Off?
events.summary: Ulta Beauty reported an 8.9% increase in fiscal second-quarter 2026 net sales, reaching $3.04 billion, with diluted earnings per share up 13.3% to $6.55. While the Space NK acquisition has expanded Ulta's market presence and contributed to scale, it has pressured the gross margin, leading to a slight decline despite overall operating leverage. The company raised its full-year sales and earnings targets, but the long-term financial benefits of Space NK are yet to be fully proven.

events.title: Chevron and Halliburton are nearing billion-dollar deals to invest in Venezuelan oil
events.summary: Chevron and Halliburton are reportedly close to signing multi-billion dollar deals to invest in Venezuelan oil fields. These agreements would mark a significant diplomatic and energy win for the Trump administration and potentially boost Venezuela's oil production, which holds some of the world's largest proven reserves. Energy Secretary Chris Wright is expected to attend the deal signings in Caracas next week, while other major oil companies like ExxonMobil and ConocoPhillips are holding off due to unresolved nationalization claims.

events.title: Royal London Asset Management Ltd. Increases Stake in Devon Energy Corporation $DVN
events.summary: Royal London Asset Management Ltd. significantly increased its holdings in Devon Energy Corporation by 520.1% in the second quarter, bringing its total stake to approximately 1.68 million shares valued at $69.6 million. This increase comes as Devon Energy reported strong quarterly earnings, exceeding analyst expectations with $1.57 EPS and $7.42 billion in revenue, and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.32 per share. Despite some recent price target reductions, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for the company with an average price target of $59.15.

events.title: THE INHERITANCE: New ConocoPhillips CEO Inherits $7 Billion Cash Flow Pledge Riding on Alaska Oil Project
events.summary: Andy O’Brien is set to take over as CEO of ConocoPhillips next month, inheriting the crucial task of completing the Willow oil project in Alaska. This project is central to the company's goal of achieving $7 billion in free cash flow growth by 2029, a plan that O'Brien has affirmed as his top priority. The company has recently underperformed peers, and O'Brien will also need to address high expectations from investors and potential further consolidation in the oil industry.

events.title: Murphy USA Stock: 6 Straight Red Days, Down 12%
events.summary: Murphy USA (MUSA) stock has experienced a six-day slide, resulting in a 12% loss and a reduction of $1.2 billion in market value, despite the S&P 500 gaining during the same period. While the stock's valuation now appears cheaper with a P/E multiple of 15.0 compared to the S&P 500 median of 23.3, its 3-year average annual revenue growth is negative. This dip prompts investors to re-evaluate their thesis, emphasizing the importance of diversification over acting solely on stock momentum.

events.title: Westpac Banking Corp Invests $2 Million in PepsiCo, Inc. $PEP
events.summary: Westpac Banking Corp initiated a new position in PepsiCo, Inc. (NASDAQ:PEP) during the second quarter, purchasing 14,774 shares valued at approximately $2 million. PepsiCo reported strong quarterly results, beating EPS and revenue estimates, and declared a quarterly dividend of $1.48 per share, resulting in a 4.2% annual yield. Institutional investors collectively own a significant 73.07% of the company, and analysts generally maintain a "Hold" rating with an average price target above the current share price.

events.title: The Manufacturers Life Insurance Company Purchases Shares of 29,588 Texas Pacific Land Corporation $TPL
events.summary: The Manufacturers Life Insurance Company acquired 29,588 shares of Texas Pacific Land Corporation (TPL) worth approximately $12.95 million during the second quarter. Despite TPL shares opening down 1.5% and trading below moving averages, the company reported an EPS of $2.23, beating estimates, and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.60. Analysts maintain a "Hold" rating with a consensus price target of $639.00.

events.title: Williams-Sonoma (WSM) Grew Comparable Brand Revenue While Non-GAAP Operating Margin Fell. Can Demand Restore Operating Leverage?
events.summary: Williams-Sonoma (WSM) saw increased comparable brand revenue across all major brands in Q2 fiscal 2026, with net revenue growing by 6.7% to $1.96 billion. However, the company's non-GAAP operating margin declined by 60 basis points to 17.3%, primarily due to a 160-basis-point drop in non-GAAP gross margin. The article questions whether stronger demand can lead to margin expansion, as operating expense leverage was insufficient to offset pressures from lower merchandise margins and tariff costs.

events.title: Demonstrators burn a U.S. flag during a protest outside YPF gas and oil company headquarters in Buenos Aires
events.summary: The article describes a protest in Buenos Aires on July 16, 2013, where demonstrators burned a U.S. flag outside YPF gas and oil company headquarters. This protest was against the Argentine government's decision to sign a deal with U.S. oil company Chevron for a $1.5 billion Vaca Muerta exploration project. The government also announced tax-free export benefits for up to 20% of crude and natural gas produced in the country to attract investment.

events.title: A 49-foot drone flew 10 to 16 feet over 74.6 miles of North Sea pipeline in a single pass, parked itself on a seabed dock to recharge and dump its data, and the Navy has now bought one, built for the oil companies that paid for all of it first
events.summary: Oceaneering International's 49-foot underwater drone, "Freedom," originally developed for oil companies like TotalEnergies to inspect North Sea pipelines, has been purchased by the U.S. Navy. This hybrid AUV/ROV can inspect long stretches of pipeline in a single pass, recharge on a seabed dock, and operate from onshore control centers, significantly reducing inspection time and emissions. The Navy's acquisition highlights a reversal in defense technology transfer, where commercial innovation is now informing military applications.

events.title: Chevron and Exxon Mobil Rise 3% as U.S. Strikes on Iran Push WTI Crude Oil to $86
events.summary: Shares of Chevron and Exxon Mobil rose 3% following U.S. military strikes on Iran over the weekend, which led to WTI crude oil climbing above $86 per barrel due to ongoing constraints in shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. While these geopolitical events provided a short-term boost to energy stocks like XLE, analysts caution that the significant year-to-date gains of Chevron (36%) and Exxon Mobil (33%) leave limited buffer if the geopolitical risk premium quickly reverses. Investors are advised to monitor Hormuz traffic and OPEC's response, as the current price surge is primarily driven by headline risk and may not reflect long-term earnings power.

events.title: ConocoPhillips Considers Selling Permian Assets Worth $2 Billion, Bloomberg News Reports
events.summary: ConocoPhillips is reportedly exploring the sale of some of its Permian Basin assets, which could fetch around $2 billion, as part of an effort to streamline its portfolio. The company is working with advisors to find a buyer, with interest expected from strategic and private equity suitors. This move follows ConocoPhillips' announcement of $3.2 billion in asset sales in 2025, as it aims to reach a $5 billion disposition target by the end of 2026.

events.title: Chevron and Halliburton Near Billion-Dollar Venezuela Oil Deals
events.summary: Chevron and Halliburton are reportedly close to striking multi-billion dollar oil deals in Venezuela, driven by the Trump administration's push to rebuild the country's oil sector. Chevron aims to expand its heavy-oil field portfolio, while Halliburton is negotiating to supply equipment and services. This development signals a significant U.S. re-engagement with Venezuela's oil industry, despite concerns from companies like ExxonMobil and ConocoPhillips regarding past nationalizations.

events.title: Chevron Corp. stock underperforms Monday when compared to competitors despite daily gains
events.summary: Shares of Chevron Corp. rallied 2.12% on Monday despite an overall down day for the stock market, marking its second consecutive day of gains. However, the stock still underperformed compared to its competitors. The S&P 500 Index and Dow Jones Industrial Average both saw declines.

events.title: EP Stock Jumps 16% as Q2 Loss Narrows, Revenues Rise Y/Y
events.summary: Empire Petroleum Corporation (EP) shares rose 16.2% following its Q2 2026 earnings report, where the company's net loss narrowed by 63% and product revenues increased by 27% year-over-year. Despite a decrease in average daily equivalent sales, the company saw improved adjusted EBITDA and expects increased activity in Texas and Louisiana, with a resolution concerning New Mexico residual-oil-zone rights also anticipated. The company acquired a 25% working interest in a Louisiana development program and completed regulatory procedures for North Dakota property interests.

events.title: 62,391 Shares in US Foods Holding Corp. $USFD Purchased by Empowered Funds LLC
events.summary: Empowered Funds LLC has acquired 62,391 shares of US Foods Holding Corp. (NYSE:USFD), valued at approximately $6.38 million, increasing institutional ownership to 98.76%. US Foods reported strong Q2 earnings, surpassing EPS and revenue expectations, and maintains a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts. events.title: Ancora Advisors LLC Makes New Investment in PepsiCo, Inc. $PEP
events.summary: Ancora Advisors LLC has made a new investment in PepsiCo, Inc. ($PEP), purchasing 62,966 shares valued at approximately $8.5 million in the second quarter. The company recently reported strong quarterly revenues of $24.18 billion and EPS of $2.20, and declared a quarterly dividend of $1.48 per share.

events.title: The Half Of Phinia’s Outlook That Actually Buys Back Stock
events.summary: Phinia (PHIN) stock has seen a 10.8% drop in the last three months despite a 17.9% gain over the past year. The company's full-year outlook for 2026 includes trimmed EBITDA guidance but raised free cash flow guidance, allowing it to continue share buybacks. Despite thin interest coverage, its strong cash generation and share count reduction make it a potential opportunity after its recent pullback.

events.title: Ranger Energy Services, Inc. entered into an agreement to acquire STEP coiled tubing, fluid and nitrogen pumping, and related well services business in the US from STEP Energy Services Ltd. for $27.5 million.
events.summary: Ranger Energy Services, Inc. has agreed to acquire STEP Energy Services Ltd.'s coiled tubing, fluid and nitrogen pumping, and related well services business in the US for $27.5 million.
